enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Eyes closed. Body still under the blanket. Remain in bed asleep. No movement.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, reading news and checking messages on phone in bed while waiting for the bathroom to be free (Member 2 is showering)
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Turn head toward the fan. Sit up in bed. Reach for the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone with thumb. Swipe up to open the news app. Scroll through headlines with thumb. Tap on an article. Scroll down the article. Press the home button. Open the messaging app. Tap on a conversation. Read messages. Type a reply on the on-screen keyboard. Send the message. Turn head toward the bedroom door. Listen for the shower running in the bathroom. Lower the phone. Wait in bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet hands under the water. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the tap. Turn on the water heater. Turn on the shower tap. Step under the water. Wet hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into hand. Rub shampoo into hair. Rinse hair. Pick up the soap. Rub soap on the body. Rinse body. Turn off the shower tap. Reach for the towel on the hook. Rub hair with the towel. Wipe the body with the towel. Wrap the towel around the body. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the bathroom light. Push the door open. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling kettle and preparing and eating breakfast, briefly sharing the kitchen with Member 2 finishing their breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the cupboard door. Take out a mug. Place the mug on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch to boil. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk and bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Take a plate from the cupboard. Place bread on the plate. Open the microwave door. Put the plate inside. Close the microwave door. Press the microwave start button. Greet Member 2 and say "Morning." Wait next to the counter. Take the plate out of the microwave when it beeps. Pour hot water from the kettle into the mug. Add a tea bag. Add milk to the mug. Stir with a spoon. Sit down at the table. Pick up the bread and eat it. Lift the mug and drink. Talk with Member 2 about the day. Put down the mug. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading news and checking messages on phone while stretching
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Open the news app. Scroll through articles with thumb. Tap on an article. Read the article. Press back. Open the messaging app. Read new messages. Type a reply. Send the reply. Put the phone down on the sofa cushion. Stand up. Raise both arms above the head. Stretch the arms upward. Bend forward at the waist. Reach toward the floor. Straighten the back up. Roll the shoulders. Turn the head left and right. Sit down on the sofa again. Pick up the phone. Scroll through more headlines.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing breakfast dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Pick up the plate from the sink. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the plate under the running tap. Rinse the plate. Place the plate in the dish rack. Pick up the mug. Scrub the mug with the sponge. Rinse the mug. Place the mug in the dish rack. Pick up the spoon. Wash the spoon. Place the spoon in the dish rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Wipe the table surface. Push the chair under the table. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely at desk on community program coordination and emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull out the desk chair. Sit down at the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the screen to load. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the email application. Click on the first email. Read the email. Click reply. Type a response on the keyboard. Click send. Open the next email. Read it. Click the calendar app. Check the day's meetings. Click on the document file. Type notes and edit the program schedule. Scroll down the document. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Pick up the phone. Check messages. Put down the phone. Open a spreadsheet. Enter data in the cells. Click the browser tab. Search for community program information. Read the page. Take a sip from the water bottle on the desk. Continue typing. Adjust the fan on the desk. Stretch the arms. Continue working. Close the document.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch on the induction cooker together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Walk to the kitchen. Meet Member 2 in the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Turn on the range hood. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with a spatula. Crack the eggs into the pan. Stir the food. Add salt. Turn off the induction cooker. Take two plates from the cupboard. Divide the food onto the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down with Member 2. Pick up chopsticks. Eat the food. Talk with Member 2 about the morning's work. Drink water from a glass. Finish eating. Put down the chopsticks.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break away from the screen
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the kitchen table. Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Close the eyes briefly. Open the eyes. Turn the head toward the window. Stand up. Walk to the window. Look outside. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Pick up the phone. Check the time. Put down the phone. Stand up. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely at desk on program planning and online meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Wake the laptop screen. Open the program planning document. Type updates on the keyboard. Click the video meeting link. Put on the headset. Speak into the microphone during the meeting. Nod the head. Write notes on paper with a pen. Mute the microphone. Unmute the microphone. Share the screen. Scroll through the slides. Answer questions aloud. End the meeting. Take off the headset. Open the email app. Read a new email. Type a reply. Click send. Open the spreadsheet. Enter figures in the cells. Save the file. Stand up. Stretch the arms. Sit down again. Continue typing. Adjust the desk lamp angle. Continue working until the meeting notes are complete.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Open the storage cupboard. Take out the vacuum cleaner. Plug the power cord into the socket. Press the power button. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Move it under the sofa. Pull it back. Vacuum along the wall. Vacuum the area near the TV. Push it around the coffee table. Press the power button to stop. Pull the plug out of the socket. Wrap the cord around the handle. Put the vacuum cleaner back in the cupboard. Close the cupboard door. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Place the cushions on the sofa. Straighten the magazines on the coffee table. Push the chairs under the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up after chores
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet hands. Pick up the soap. Rub soap on the hands. Rinse hands under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Wipe the neck. Hang the towel back on the hook. Look in the mirror. Adjust the hair with the hands. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner on the induction cooker together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out meat and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the meat on the cutting board. Cut the vegetables. Turn on the range hood. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Add the meat to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add the vegetables. Add soy sauce. Stir the food. Turn off the induction cooker. Take two bowls from the cupboard. Spoon rice into the bowls. Carry the bowls and plates to the table. Sit down with Member 2. Pick up chopsticks. Eat the food. Talk with Member 2 about the day. Drink water. Finish eating. Put down the chopsticks.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the table. Carry the plates and bowls to the sink. Place them in the sink. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the plates under the running tap. Rinse the plates. Place the plates in the dish rack. Scrub the bowls. Rinse the bowls. Place the bowls in the dish rack. Scrub the chopsticks. Rinse the chopsticks. Place them in the dish rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up a cloth. Wipe the counter surface. Wipe the induction cooker surface. Wipe the table. Turn off the range hood. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV to relax, joined by Member 2 until 20:00
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Member 2 sits down on the sofa. Talk with Member 2 about the program. Press the volume button on the remote. At 20:00 Member 2 stands up and says "Good night, I'm heading to my room." Wave a hand. Continue watching TV. Press the channel button again. Watch the screen. Press the power button on the remote. Put down the remote on the sofa arm. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal time on computer and phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the browser. Click on a video website. Play a video. Watch the screen. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Open a social media app. Scroll through posts with the thumb. Tap on a post. Read the comments. Press the home button. Open a game app. Tap the screen to play. Put down the phone. Continue watching the video on the laptop. Click pause. Click play. Open the messaging app on the laptop. Type a message. Click send. Close the browser. Close the laptop lid. Push back the chair. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down quietly before bed while Member 2 uses the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back. Fold the hands on the lap. Look at the TV screen that is switched off. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Check the time on the screen. Put down the phone. Stand up. Walk to the window. Look outside. Turn around. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Breathe out slowly. Stand up. Walk toward the bathroom door and wait.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet the hands. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the bathroom door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for bed and turning off the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Close the bedroom door. Pull back the blanket on the bed. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Take off the slippers. Place the slippers beside the bed. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Press the desk lamp switch to turn it off. Walk back to the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Adjust the pillow under the head. Turn the head toward the fan. Close the eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed asleep. Eyes closed. Body still under the blanket. No movement.
